newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Diablo Canyon unit at full power Fri.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Diablo Canyon unit at full power Fri.

text.p: Pacific Gas & Electric Co expects its 1,087 megawatt Diablo Canyon 1 nuclear power plant to be back at full power by Friday, Nov 29, one week after it tripped off line, company spokesman Jeff Lewis said Monday.
He said the unit likely would begin the restart process on Thursday following repairs needed after a fire late last Friday in an auxiliary power grounding transformer.
The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said earlier Monday the unit was expected to return to service on Wednesday.
The adjacent unit 2 at the Diablo Canyon facility, rated at 1,073 megawatts, was not affected by the outage in unit 1 and is operating at full power, Lewis said.
The Diablo Canyon facility is at Avila Beach on the central California coast.
